outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured microscopy images from a photoactivation time-lapse with no quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively)
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents averaged intensity curves with error bars/data spread (insets show averaged early time point responses with error bars) implying pooled replicate data, but the caption never states how many replicates (cells/experiments) were averaged nor the type of replicate used.
